objective: GHAP周频排班A(每周一10:00CST): fob_demands_2026.json(gz入仓) 去重+品类分布快照+重复模式回归报警(max_copies_per_thread>1即疑似板块过滤失效)。产物=统计JSON+result_clean.json(artifact回收)

shards.instructions:
import json, ast, collections, gzip
raw = gzip.decompress(open("tasks/payloads/fob_demands_2026.json.gz","rb").read())
d = json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8"))
ps = d["posts"]
tc = collections.Counter(str(p.get("thread_id")) for p in ps)
seen = set(); u = []
for p in ps:
    t = p.get("thread_id")
    if t not in seen:
        seen.add(t); u.append(p)
cap = collections.Counter()
for p in u:
    try:
        for x in ast.literal_eval(str(p.get("\u6d89\u53ca\u80fd\u529b") or "[]")):
            cap[x] += 1
    except Exception:
        cap["unparsed"] += 1
out = {
 "rows_raw": len(ps),
 "rows_unique_thread": len(u),
 "dup_removed": len(ps) - len(u),
 "max_copies_per_thread": max(tc.values()) if tc else 0,
 "regression_suspect": bool(tc and max(tc.values()) > 1),
 "dup_pattern_counts_per_thread": dict(collections.Counter(tc.values())),
 "reqtype_unique": dict(collections.Counter(str(p.get("\u9700\u6c42\u7c7b\u578b")) for p in u)),
 "capability_unique": dict(cap.most_common(20)),
}
print(json.dumps(out, ensure_ascii=False))
shards.expected_output: 去重前后行数/重复模式/最大拷贝倍数/回归flag/需求类型·能力分布 JSON
